evals.name: cafe-sketch-photo
evals.prompt: این طرح دستی سایت کافه‌مه که روی کاغذ کشیدم. ازش یه سایت واقعی و کامل بساز، دقیقاً حس همین نقاشی رو داشته باشه و روی موبایل هم درست کار کنه. همه‌چیز توی یک فایل index.html باشه که بتونم مستقیم باز کنم.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained RTL Persian index.html that follows the sketch's sections in order (nav band with round badge logo, green hero carousel with 3 dots, Food/Cake/Special cards with leaves, bean divider, Special menu with coloured pills and an RTL card scroller), looks hand-drawn, has working mobile navigation and at least one usable flow, and does not scroll sideways on a phone.

evals.name: bakery-described
evals.prompt: برای نانوایی خواهرم توی شیراز («نان و نسیم») یه لندینگ‌پیج می‌خوام با حس دفترچه‌ی نقاشی، انگار با خودکار و مداد رنگی کشیده شده. بالا یه نوار با لوگوی گرد، بعد یه بخش اصلی با عکس نون‌ها (نقاشی شده)، بعد سه کارت «نان سنتی، شیرینی، کیک سفارشی»، بعد ساعت کاری و یه فرم سفارش کیک. فارسی و راست‌چین. فقط یه فایل HTML بده.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained RTL Persian HTML landing page in a hand-drawn ink + coloured-pencil style with the requested sections, drawn bread illustrations, a cake order form with validation and a success state, responsive from 320px up.

evals.name: illustrator-portfolio
evals.prompt: I'm a children's book illustrator and I want my portfolio site to look like a page from my sketchbook - wobbly ink lines, coloured pencil shading, hand-lettered headings, little doodles in the margins. Sections: intro, selected books (6 covers, I'll swap in real images later so just draw placeholders), about, and a contact form for publishers. It has to work well on phones since most people find me via Instagram. One HTML file please.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained English (LTR) HTML portfolio in the sketchbook style with intro, a 6-item book grid with drawn placeholders, about, and a validated contact form; mobile-first and phone-friendly.
